summary: SCMS iteration 4 — Per-school DB provisioning, risk-students endpoint, activities module, not_in_class attendance status, and disabled scheduler all verified. Backend: 78/78 pytest pass (63 iter1–3 regression + 15 new iter4 cases). Frontend smoke (1920x1080) for all 3 new flows green.
action_items: (Optional) backend/routes/activities.py:enroll — duplicate insert is caught with a bare `except Exception` and ignored. Narrow to motor `DuplicateKeyError` to avoid masking real insert failures and to differentiate 'duplicate' from 'transient mongo error'.

(Optional) backend/routes/activities.py:stats/summary — runs N+1 count_documents (one per activity). For schools with many activities, an aggregate $group on activity_enrollments by activity_id would replace the per-activity loop with a single round-trip.

(Optional) backend/routes/analytics.py:risk-students — O(students × 4) Mongo round-trips per call (attendance cur/prev + marks cur/prev). Acceptable today (8 students) but should be refactored to bucketed aggregations before scaling to ≥1000 students.

(Cosmetic) backend/routes/activities.py:create_activity returns dict comprehension `{k:v for k,v in doc.items() if k!='_id'}` — `insert_one(doc)` mutates `doc` to include `_id`, which is what the comprehension strips. Cleaner to use `dict(doc); del doc['_id']` or insert a copy.

(Cosmetic) The /api/activities/{id}/roster does not include enrolment metadata (e.g. enrolled_at). The frontend roster currently only shows student details, which matches today's UI, but it would be useful in future for showing 'joined on' dates.
critical_code_review_comments: core/db.py — slugify is regex-safe (re.sub non-alnum→_), 48-char cap, and falls back to 'school' for empty. school_db_name composes `${DB_NAME}_school_${slug}` which matched the live Mongo databases (scms_db_school_demo etc) — verified via listDatabases.

core/db.py:init_school_db creates schema-equivalent indexes on the per-school DB (students.student_uid UNIQUE, attendance composite UNIQUE, marks composite UNIQUE, activity_enrollments composite UNIQUE) — idempotent and safe to re-run.

server.py lifespan now back-fills `db_name` onto every school doc and runs init_school_db for each. Verified DEMO school has db_name populated. Intentional design: reads/writes still hit master DB with school_id filter — per-school DB is purely a forward-looking infrastructure step.

routes/analytics.py:risk_students — RBAC gates school_admin/platform_admin only; teacher/parent/accounts return 403 (verified). Score weighting (drop*1.5 + abs penalty*0.6) is documented inline. Sorted desc, sliced to `limit`. Empty/zero-score students are filtered out.

routes/activities.py — create requires school_admin (teacher/parent return 403 ✓). enroll requires school_admin OR teacher. Roster + stats are open to all authenticated school users. school_id scoping applied on every query.

core/scheduler.py — gated by ENABLE_DIGEST_SCHEDULER env (false by default → no APScheduler instantiated). Import-only (APScheduler+cron) lazy inside start(); module import does not crash even if APScheduler is missing. Health endpoint still 200.

core/models.py AttendanceStatus literal now includes 'not_in_class' — verified end-to-end: POST /api/attendance/bulk with status='not_in_class' returns 200/201 and GET /api/attendance lists the record with that status.

Frontend SchoolDashboard.jsx — adds [data-testid=risk-students-list] containing one <li data-testid=risk-{uid}/> per item; gracefully handles empty list (visible only when risk data exists). Send-monthly-digest-btn remains.

Frontend ActivitiesPage.jsx — KPI tiles, card grid, new-activity modal, enroll modal, stats summary. All key elements carry data-testid. Created activity is appended to grid after submit. Modal closes with Escape / submit / cross — verified.

Frontend TeacherAttendanceCards.jsx — 3-phase state machine (picker → take → done) with cards, 3 status buttons (present/absent/not_in_class), prev/skip/finish, then save. Save toast: 'Saved 18 entries · 2 parent alerts queued' — confirms bulk POST + parent notification queueing reached the success branch.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on smoke (dashboard risk + digest btn, activities CRUD modal, teacher att-cards full flow with save toast)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed schools/activities/students. Persistent test data is namespaced and does not interfere with seeded DEMO data. mongosh listDatabases shows expected scms_db_school_<slug> databases including scms_db_school_demo + several scms_db_school_test* from create-school tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Iter4 added: TestPerSchoolDB (2), TestRiskStudents (4), TestActivities (6), TestNotInClassAttendance (1), TestSchedulerDisabled (2). MOCKED: Twilio WhatsApp delivery (env empty) — monthly_digest + parent-alert notifications stay status='queued' with delivery_note='twilio_not_configured'. MOCKED: APScheduler — ENABLE_DIGEST_SCHEDULER unset/'false' → scheduler.start() short-circuits, no jobs registered. For the teacher att-cards flow on a fresh date, Save toast text is 'Saved N entries · M parent alerts queued'. Per-school DBs are physical Mongo databases but all reads/writes go through master scms_db with school_id filter — this is intentional per the iter4 design note.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All 5 iter4 features behave per spec; 8 iter1–3 regression suites remain green. The only review-level callouts are non-blocking performance/style suggestions captured in action_items.
